description: This file defines a PHP class for a Bezier smoothed line chart as part of the Image_Graph plotting library, specifically for rendering smoothed line plots using Bezier curves.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Line
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering Bezier smoothed line charts in the Image_Graph library, extending the base Bezier smoothed plot class.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the fill style of the element, here it returns a transparent color.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the line in the legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the smoothed line plot, including handling of dataset points, control points, and drawing splines.
